children: BOARD APPROVES ENTERING INTO FINANCIAL SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT IN IMPLEMENTATION OF COURT JUDGMENT IN FAVOR OF QATAR NATIONAL BANK
UPON EXECUTION OF SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT, CO TO PAY AGREED FINAL SETTLEMENT AMOUNT OF AED 91 MILLION IN FAVOR OF QATAR NATIONAL BANK
PAYMENT IN INSTALLMENTS OVER A PERIOD OF TWO YEARS
DISPUTE BETWEEN CO AND QATAR NATIONAL BANK WILL BE FULLY AND FINALLY SETTLED
FOLLOWING AGREEMENT EXECUTION, NO FURTHER GROUNDS FOR INITIATING PREVENTIVE SETTLEMENT OR RESTRUCTURING PROCEEDINGS
